scientific_integrity: The twenty-two negative curves are proved exhaustive using nef anticanonical geometry, adjunction and Cauchy--Schwarz; the finite support count is independently reproduced with exact recurrence and exhaustive enumeration. The computation cannot by itself certify the geometric premises.
scientific_limitations: The exact count concerns the complex minimal resolution of a cubic surface with a single ordinary node, represented as the blow-up of six distinct points with exactly one collinear triple and no six-point conic. It does not count chambers of the singular cubic or classify other degenerations. General negative-definite-support theorems are cited, not newly proved. Historical priority is provisional and specialist comparison of other tables remains necessary.
title: Zariski-chamber support profile of a one-nodal cubic surface resolution
